scope: Actual source-matched Verilated board-profile GPU at 50.4 MHz, with 25.2 MHz virtual host and pixels. Timed from identical wire bytes through fence, with equal settings, first-use upload bytes and residency. Each matched test checks both complete RGB565 buffers and every D24 word with independent SRR at the start and end. No physical throughput inference.

continuous.release_gate: No cumulative fence delay. Retain individual increases and interpret using matched starts.

flat_kind4_start_phase_audit.scope: Natural rows trace the same continuous standard case after all normal prior commands, using identical timings to the standard executables. Cross-plays start each model at the same video phase as the named natural row, modulo one frame, after an ordinary boot and at least one complete idle frame. Within each cross-play pair all attachment words, live SDRAM and FIFO phase and timed packet bytes match. Original prior DRAW and SDRAM history is retained in the natural rows and is distinct from the common boot histories in the cross-plays. Flat ico clears both tile attachments before rendering and discards depth; its measured depth scratch starts from CLEAR in both histories.

matched_scope: Raw kind-4 wire and the independent decoded renderer are unchanged. The suite includes accepted triangles of both signs, culled negative winding, extreme, nearly-flat and constant depth plus seeded LOAD/STORE with nonuniform prior attachments. It compares each foreground start, both full RGB565 and D24, attachment validity, render covered/missed counts and scanout underflow.

setup_profile.scope: Pre-edge RTL counters. The unchanged guard, launches and arithmetic yield exactly the expected divider-clock and setup-clock reductions. Alternative wider leading-zero skips are hypothetical upper bounds.

record_fetch_investigation.scope: Baseline record wait measurement uses real RTL. Cache figures are offline trace estimates at one replay word per clock. No cache was added.
